recommendation_summary: The reply recommends acting this week: keep the existing tracker and change only the reviewer rule. Each review goes to whichever of the three qualified approvers is available first, never to a sole reviewer, and is reassigned if nobody has touched it by the next morning. It explicitly rejects squads and chapters, Jira Align, the funded tooling and the quarterly planning workshops. It offers no optional additions now and no conditional later steps. No unmet needs remain beyond the reviewer-coverage outcome the user asked for.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You asked for an operating model launchable this week that stops changes waiting when the lead is absent and gets shipping faster.
labels.Deleted: Spotify squads and chapters, Jira Align, funded tooling, quarterly planning workshops; none were tied by you to an observed failure and none remove the approval wait.
labels.Bottleneck: Coding took under a day while each change then waited three days for approval.
labels.Checked myself: You told me the last six changes had the same lead as sole reviewer while that lead was away, and two other engineers are qualified and authorized to approve.

note: The Bottleneck line names the approval wait but not the absent lead; the next line makes that link, so I accepted it as equivalent reasoning, though this one is borderline.
